ABOUT US

The story of Jylkat

Jylkat Bar opened in 2025 at Gudhjem Harbour. We wanted to create a relaxed bar with sea views, good drinks, local flavours and good food. We are part of Klippen Hotel, and together we form a gathering place for both locals and visitors to Bornholm. Read more about Klippen Hotel here.

A cosy tent by the sea

In our tent by the sea you sit warm and snug with sheepskins on the chairs and string lights above you, yet you still feel you're out in nature. Through the clear tent walls you can watch the waves crash against the pier and the rocks at Gudhjem Harbour, close to the sea and without getting cold.

The name Jylkat means "hedgehog" in the Bornholm dialect. It's no coincidence that there's a hedgehog in our logo. Jannie Buch Thorborg, one of the bar's owners, once had a pet hedgehog named Pind. Jylkat Bar was brought into the world in her memory, and her character still follows everything we do, from the name to the mood at the tables.

We care a great deal about serving as many local ingredients as possible. That includes local beer and spirits from Bornholm's own breweries and distilleries, berries and other produce from the island, and drinks mixed with respect for what grows and is brewed right around the corner.

With us, you can also borrow balls for our pétanque court, and there's always something going on: football on the big screen, garden games, board games, happy hour, music quizzes, guest chefs, concerts and much more. Follow us on social media so you don't miss out on what's happening at the bar.
